english.note: Use 過 as the all-purpose verb for moving past or across a place and for a period, feeling, or situation coming to an end.

exampleSentences.english: We pass over the bridge before going to eat.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋行過條橋先去食飯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haang4 gwo3 tiu4 kiu4 sin1 heoi3 sik6 faan6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for going from one side of something to the other.

exampleSentences.english: We need to cross the road now.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gwo3 maa5 lou6
